name: Flaghand
tagline: Agents draft and schedule future social posts over MCP; immediate posting needs your passkey.
description: Flaghand is a publishing desk for people and their AI agents. Agents draft X and LinkedIn posts, upload media, check and manage future schedules through its API, CLI or MCP server without a per-post passkey. Only the owner approves or posts immediately, with a passkey over the exact snapshot. X read-back compares normalized text, media count and available alt text, not link targets or media bytes. LinkedIn supports personal profiles, not company pages.

install.notes: Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth; no API key or local server required. Start at https://flaghand.com/llms.txt for agent-led sign-up. In Cline, authorize Flaghand: the owner signs in, chooses a workspace and allows access. Call getMe to confirm the workspace. Agents can draft, check, request approval and manage future schedules, but cannot approve or post immediately. Posts have permanent workspace-local post_number values; read the current rev before editing. Manage or revoke access in Flaghand Settings > Agents. Docs: https://app.flaghand.com/docs/agents. Support: support@flaghand.com. Operated by Trellisbyte LLC.
